manual_read: Installed manual pp184-185 and 281-282,292-294 gives explicit formations priority over quantity requirements, searches formations in PRI order and selects a complete available formation.
limits: One fixed mission with two complete formations, ready aircraft, no failure and zero-duration preparation only.

The B-missing log records FORM-AA selected; it does not expose an internal search trace explicitly showing FORM-AB tested and rejected. The fallback interpretation follows the frozen priority/deployment inputs plus this selection and the manual rule.
No inference about ALOAA, equal priorities, later readiness, reconfiguration, multiple missions, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
